example_sentences_in_bangla: প্রকল্পটি সরকারের কাছ থেকে সবুজবাতি পেয়েছে।
ম্যানেজার সবুজবাতি দিয়ে কাজ শুরু করার অনুমতি দিয়েছেন।
example_sentences_in_english: The project has received the green light from the government.
The manager gave the green light to start the work.
history: This idiom originates from traffic signal terminology, where a green light indicates permission to proceed, adapted into Bengali in urban contexts during the 20th century with the introduction of modern traffic systems.
note: Borrowed from English but widely used in Bengali media and official language.
